recentItems.title: Why was it so hard to reopen the road to Gyirong Port?
recentItems.description:
Less than 5 meters in two hours. What made the road so difficult to reopen?
No road. Fast-flowing water. Unstable slopes. Massive rocks.
Watch how rescuers tackled one obstacle after another to reopen the route to the core area of Gyirong Port. #GyirongPort #Xizang #China #Rescue

recentItems.title: GLOBALink | What it's like to hike with AI-powered exoskeleton
recentItems.description: Just hiked Beijing's Fragrant Hills with the Viatrix exoskeleton -- developed by Shanghai-based startup ULSrobotics. It adapts to your stride in two seconds, cuts effort by 40 percent, and makes steep trails feel effortless. Similar devices are now popping up at tourist spots across China. Click this video to see how AI-powered wearables are transforming the way we move.  #FutureChina

recentItems.title: Chinese-led port project opens new career paths for Tanzanians
recentItems.description: Local Tanzanians comprise about 80 percent of some 500 employees now building the Chinese-led Zanzibar Mangapwani new port project. For workers Abdallah and Mndeli, the project's effects are already felt in promotions earned, skills acquired and new professional ambitions. It's a legacy that goes beyond the infrastructure, touching the lives of locals. #China #Africa #Tanzania #Zanzibar #CHEC #Infrastructure #LocalEmployment

recentItems.title: Foreign tourists flock to Chongqing, explore more of China
recentItems.description:
They saw China online. Now they're here.
From viral videos of Chongqing to exploring 10+ Chinese cities, foreign travelers are coming to China to see it for themselves.
#Chongqing #ChinaTravel #InboundTourism

recentItems.title: I left a part of my heart in China
recentItems.description:
"I left a part of my heart in China."
Upon returning home to the U.S., retired teacher Ronald Sakolsky reflected on his 10-day trip to China, recalling his touching reunion with former students and desertification fighter Yin Yuzhen. #China #Friendship #Reunion

recentItems.title: LIVE: Discover Chongqing, China's "8D magical city" from the river
recentItems.description: Ever wonder why Chongqing is called an "8D magical city"? Join #Xinhua live as we cruise along the rivers and take in the city from a new perspective. Let's discover the city where mountains, rivers, buildings, and bridges intertwine in ways you won't find anywhere else.
